title: Ask HN: Are companies making money by using AI?
excerpt: There are companies making money in this business. They have names like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc….
content_html:
There are companies making money in this business. They have names like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc….

Then there are other companies in this business who are also making money. They have names like Amazon, Google, Meta, etc….

Then there are some more companies who are making money in this business. They have names like NVIDIA, Intel, AMD, etc….

Now, how much profit any of them are making, compared to their costs and their committed outlays, that’s a different matter.

But while you’re riding that bubble, it is vital that you always sell the crap out of those shovels, so that you can keep making that bubble bigger.
